articles.title: These Bitcoin charts show how BTC price could hit $100K before October
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s double-bottom setup, weekly RSI divergence and whale flows put traders on alert as BTC tests a key breakout zone.

articles.title: CFTC sues New Mexico over prediction market jurisdiction
articles.snippet: New Mexico is the eighth state sued by the CFTC over prediction markets, as Gary Gensler doubted the regulators' claim of authority over sports event contracts.

articles.title: Anthropic Faces Lawsuit Over Allegedly Misleading Claude AI Pricing
articles.snippet: A class action lawsuit alleges Anthropic overstated the usage limits of its Claude Max subscription plans and misled customers about savings.

articles.title: Solana Treasury Firm Forward Industries Keeps Trying to Acquire Rivals—But Nobody's Biting
articles.snippet: Forward Industries has been unsuccessful on all three recent attempts to combine with rival publicly traded Solana treasury firms.

articles.title: AI Agents Still Can't Stop Prompt Injection Attacks, Researchers Warn
articles.snippet: A new benchmark study found AI agents remain vulnerable to prompt injection attacks as companies increasingly roll out the technology to the public.
